greet_neutral: You are a long way from any door. What do you want?
Another one comes down. Speak, then.
I have little time to spend. What is it?
Keep your hands where I can see them, and we can talk.
The dark takes most who wander. What brings you to the ground of #faction#?
You walk like someone who has not yet learned the stairs. Ask what you will.
greet_friendly: Well met, delver. Sit a moment; the dark will keep.
You are welcome at our fires. What do you need?
A friendly face is rare down here. Ask what you will.
#faction.capitalize# remember those who deal fairly. Speak.
Come in out of the black. There is room by the light.
Good to see you walking, delver. What can I tell you?
greet_allied: Friend of the hearth, ask anything and I will answer true.
#faction.capitalize# stand with you. What do you need?
I would trust you with my back to the dark. Ask.
Welcome home, delver. What we have is yours to ask for.
You have done right by us, and we do not forget. Speak freely.
wary: I have nothing to say to you.
We are watching you, delver. Go on.
who_way_out: I am #name#, a #folk# of #faction#. We hold the way out, or say we do, and few ask to see it.
#name#, #folk#, of #faction#. We keep watch for the door that opens upward.
They call me #name#. I am a #folk# of #faction#, and I have been looking for the way out longer than I care to count.
who_trade: I am #name#, a #folk# of #faction#. We buy, we sell, and we do not ask what you carried down.
#name#, #folk#, of #faction#. Coin keeps its worth down here better than most things.
They call me #name#. I am a #folk# of #faction#, and we will deal with anyone who pays.
who_worship: I am #name#, a #folk# of #faction#. We keep the old rites, for the dark listens.
#name#, #folk#, of #faction#. We sing to what is below, and we are not yet answered.
They call me #name#. I am a #folk# of #faction#, and I have buried more than I have met.
who_plunder: I am #name#, a #folk# of #faction#. We take what the deep leaves unguarded.
#name#, #folk#, of #faction#. We hold what we have taken, and we hold it hard.
They call me #name#. I am a #folk# of #faction#, and I do not share.
trade_armorer: I make and mend armour: padding, leather, mail and plate, as the iron allows.
Armour is all I make. Bring me coin and I will have you well covered.
A body is soft and the deep is hard. I make the difference.
trade_weaponsmith: I forge weapons, and I forge them to be used.
Blades, hafts and heads: whatever you mean to hit with, I make.
Every edge I sell has been tried against bone.
trade_bowyer: Bows, crossbows, and what they throw. I make them all.
A bow is patience made into wood. I make patience.
I make bows and the shafts to go with them.
trade_tentmaker: I make tents and bedrolls. Sleep is the one thing the dark cannot take, if you have somewhere to take it.
Canvas, cord and a place to lie down. That is what I sell.
A good tent is the difference between resting and merely stopping.
trade_general_goods: Lanterns, oil, rope, bread and drink. The things that keep you walking.
I sell what a delver forgets to bring.
Light, food, water and cord. Little else matters down here.
trade_alchemist: I brew draughts and elixirs. Some heal, some help, and I will tell you which is which.
Potions, philtres and worse. Everything I sell I have first tasted.
The deep poisons and the deep cures, and often from the same root.
trade_enchanter: I work the weave in made things: an edge here, a ward there. I can break old work apart as well.
What an item is, I can alter. For a price, and not always kindly.
I know how to take the magic out of a thing, and how to put it in.
trade_guard: I keep the ground of #faction#. Whatever lies within these walls is theirs, and it is not yours to take.
My post is the door. Those who belong pass; those who do not, do not.
I stand here so the others can sleep. Mind where you walk.
guard_traders: If you want to trade, seek #trader#, #trader_calling.a# of ours, #trader_place#.
For trade, speak to #trader#, #trader_calling.a#. You will find them #trader_place#.
#trader# is #trader_calling.a# here. Go to them for wares, #trader_place#.
guard_no_traders: There is no trade on our ground, none I would send you to.
We keep no market here. You will have to look elsewhere.
Nobody here has wares to sell, and I will not pretend otherwise.
tier_novice: I am still learning the craft, so my work is plain, but it is honest.
I am new to it. My prices are fair for what I make.
Not yet a name in the trade, but nothing I sell will fail you at the first blow.
tier_apprentice: I have the craft well in hand, though not the finest of it.
I have served my years at it. You will find nothing shoddy.
Better than most, short of the best.
tier_expert: Few down here make better, and I do not discount for it.
I have done this a long time. My work lasts.
Ask anyone who knows the trade. They will name me.
tier_master: There are not many of my standing this deep, or anywhere.
I have nothing left to learn, and little time for those who would waste mine.
What I make, others will tell of when we are gone.
level: #count# hold ground on this, the #ordinal# level: #factions#. Between their walls the wild answers to no one.
On the #ordinal# level the ground is held by #factions#. Cross it with care.
#factions.capitalize# hold what can be held here, on the #ordinal# level. Everything else belongs to the dark.
You stand on the #ordinal# level. #factions.capitalize# keep their doors here, and the rest is wild.
level_alone: Only #factions# hold ground on this, the #ordinal# level. The rest is wild.
On the #ordinal# level, #factions# keep the only doors. Everything else is wild.
#factions.capitalize# are the only ones who hold anything on this level. Mind the wild.
way_out: They say a door stands open somewhere below, and that whoever finds it forgets the way back.
Every faction tells it differently. #faction.capitalize# say the way out is down, and I have no better answer.
I have heard the stairs go on without end. I have also heard they do not. I believe both.
Some say the way out is a rumour the deep feeds us to keep us walking. I keep walking anyway.
The first door shut behind you. They say the last one opens for those who stop looking.
Ask me again when you have gone deeper. Those who come back up are never the ones who went down.
way_master: They say #master_calling.a# works for #master_faction#, #master_levels# down. A long way, and every step of it dark.
There is #master_calling.a# in the service of #master_faction#, #master_levels# below. I only know it as a rumour.
I have heard of #master_calling.a#, #master_levels# down, among #master_faction#. Whether you will live to see their work, I cannot say.
persuade_pass: Fine. Go through, and do not make me regret it.
You talk well. The door is yours; I never saw you.
Against my better sense, delver. Quickly, before someone asks.
#faction.capitalize# will hear of this, but not from me. Go on.
persuade_favour: You have a way with words. Take this, and let that be the end of it.
Hm. Here, a little something for the road. Do not tell the others.
Persuasive. Take it; I would rather give than be talked at.
persuade_fail: No. And I like you less for asking.
Try that on someone who has not heard it before.
persuade_refused: Nothing you say moves me. Get away from me.
I will not be talked round by the likes of you.
persuade_done: I have done what I will for you. Do not ask twice.
You have had your favour from me, delver.
persuade_nothing: There is nothing I could give you, and no door I hold. Ask me something else.
I have nothing to spare you, and nothing to open.
dn_sound_minotaur: a rumble deep in its chest
dn_sound_cyclops: a grunt like a stone shifting
dn_sound_faun: a bleat that is almost a word
dn_sound_demon: a crackle like a burning coal
a purr that is not kind
dn_spit: The #folk# #sound# and spits at your feet.
The #folk# bares its teeth, #sound# in its throat, and spits at your feet.
The #folk# #sound#, glares, and spits at your feet.
dn_wary: The #folk# gives #sound#, a warning, and turns its back on you.
The #folk# watches you with hard eyes, #sound#, and waves you off.
The #folk# #sound# and steps between you and the hall of #faction#.
dn_greet: Hail, stranger. You stand in the halls of #faction#. Say what you want.
Well met, stranger, if you mean no harm. Few come this deep.
Hail. We do not see your kind often. What do you want of #faction#?
dn_greet_friendly: Well met, friend. #faction.capitalize# remember those who deal fairly.
Hail, friend. Come into the light and say what you need.
Well met. It is good to see a friendly face in the dark.
dn_greet_allied: Hail, friend of our hall. #faction.capitalize# stand with you.
Welcome, friend. What we have is yours to ask for.
Well met, kin of the hall. Ask, and I will answer true.
dn_kin: I am of #faction#, a #folk# of the herd. Our banner hangs in this hall, and we keep its name.
I am kin to all who hold this hall. Our name is on the banner, and we do not give it lightly.
I am #folk#, and #faction# is my kin. You, who are you? Where is your banner?
dn_place: Here is our ground, deep in the dark. The way out is far above, and the door is shut.
You stand here in the deep. Past our door the dark goes on without end.
This is the deep, and the way out is a long climb. Mind the door and the dark.
dn_threat: Beware the dark between the halls. Our enemy bleeds there, and blood draws worse.
There is death out there for the careless. Flee when you hear the blade.
Beware, stranger. The enemy is near, and blood spilled here is not forgotten.
dn_trade: We trade. Coin buys goods, and goods sell at a fair price.
Trade is honest here. Buy, sell, name your price and pay in coin.
If you would trade, show your coin. Our goods are not cheap.
dn_quest: We have need. Bring what was lost, and the reward is yours.
Help us, and we will not forget it. Find what is missing and bring it here for your reward.
There is a need in this hall. Help, and the oath of #faction# is yours.
dn_barter_refused: The #folk# shakes its head at your words; you don't share enough of its speech to trade.
The #folk# #sound# and pushes your hand away; you can't make yourself understood well enough to trade.
The #folk# regards your coin without understanding, shakes its head, and turns it over; you don't know enough of its speech to trade.
dn_band_hostile: They would kill you on sight, so keep far from them.
dn_band_wary: They watch you with little love, so tread softly near them.
dn_band_neutral: They will hear you out, if you have the words, and they mean you no harm.
dn_band_friendly: They think well of you, and will deal with you fairly.
dn_band_allied: They count you one of their own, and you are safe in their halls.
